detailed_descriptions.en: Work at a soap and wash service catering specifically to dragons! Dragon customers have needs you are well equipped to fulfill with your wash tools, your hands, and more to keep spirits high. Enjoy a casually paced hands on and direct process of pampering dragons, and tend to some spicy requests as customers grow more comfortable with the care you provide. Only contains male dragons, male on male dragons, and male dragon on player content. Game content is approximately 90 minutes per ending, with three endings.
